summary: The v5 twelve-parent diagnostic recorded 343/576 confirmation answers for feedback-aware direct investigation and 331/576 for outcome-masked investigation (paired difference +12 answers). Fixed probing scored 364/576 and repair-only 365/576. These are parents within three authored native contracts, not independent mechanism or transfer evidence. The separate finite witness-learner demonstration used 16 more acquisition source calls than its generic control; it does not show an acquired-question gain.

No transfer or acquired memory claim.
